pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

2. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

3. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

4. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 44
   C. 105
   D. 30

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 77
   C. 22
   D. 18

8. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

9. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

11. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

12. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
